governing_rule: Show the evidence-to-governance-principle-to-classification bridge without duplicating the investigation or reopening Section 03.
schema_and_tooling_ambiguities: source_clause_analysis provides one table-level source_record_order and source_url rather than row-level source references, so multi-source incidents require selection of one best supporting source even where corroboration spans records.

The schema does not define whether classification-disputed Section 03 mappings should receive a public reasoning bridge; this pass leaves those four records for human adjudication rather than making a disputed mapping appear settled.

Canonical Incident records have no field for the terminal states ASSESSMENT_NOT_JUSTIFIED or HUMAN_ADJUDICATION_REQUIRED, so those defensible no-table dispositions are maintained in this review inventory.

This repository provides canonical/public-index builders and validators but no public case-page or PDF renderer; renderer-level visual checks must be performed in the downstream publication repository.
